// KQL-03519 — Machine inventory overview
// Dashboard-ready version: Neutral Observability baseline.
let InventoryLookback = totimespan(_inventoryLookback);
let LatestInventory =
    System_MachineInventory
    | where Timestamp between (
        _endTime - InventoryLookback .. _endTime
    )
    | summarize arg_max(
        Timestamp,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HwManufacturer,
        HwModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
    ) by Host
    | extend HardwareModel = trim(
        " ",
        strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel)
    )
    | extend HardwareModel = iff(
        isempty(HardwareModel),
        "Unknown",
        HardwareModel
    )
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where OsPlatform in (_osPlatform) or isempty(_osPlatform)
    | where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
    | where OsVersion in (_osVersion) or isempty(_osVersion)
    | where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel)
        or isempty(_hardwareModel);
LatestInventory
| summarize
    Machines = dcount(Host),
    VirtualMachines = countif(HwIsVirtualMachine == true),
    PhysicalMachines = countif(HwIsVirtualMachine == false),
    UnknownVirtualization = countif(isnull(HwIsVirtualMachine)),
    AverageRAMGB = round(avg(RAMSizeGB), 1),
    AverageLogicalCPUs = round(
        avg(todouble(CPUCoresLogical)),
        1
    ),
    Manufacturers = dcount(HwManufacturer),
    Models = dcount(HardwareModel),
    LatestInventory = max(Timestamp)

// KQL-03520 — Host observability coverage matrix
// Dashboard-ready version: filters all hosts through latest inventory.
let InventoryLookback = totimespan(_inventoryLookback);
let LatestInventory =
    System_MachineInventory
    | where Timestamp between (
        _endTime - InventoryLookback .. _endTime
    )
    | summarize arg_max(
        Timestamp,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HwManufacturer,
        HwModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
    ) by Host
    | extend HardwareModel = trim(
        " ",
        strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel)
    )
    | extend HardwareModel = iff(
        isempty(HardwareModel),
        "Unknown",
        HardwareModel
    )
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where OsPlatform in (_osPlatform) or isempty(_osPlatform)
    | where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
    | where OsVersion in (_osVersion) or isempty(_osVersion)
    | where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel)
        or isempty(_hardwareModel);
let FilteredHosts =
    LatestInventory
    | project Host;
union
    (
        System_MachineInventory
        | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
        | project Host, Source = "Inventory", EventTime = Timestamp
    ),
    (
        License_LicenseInfo
        | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
        | project Host, Source = "Agent", EventTime = Timestamp
    ),
    (
        System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
        | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
        | project Host, Source = "Performance", EventTime = Timestamp
    ),
    (
        Session_SessionDetail
        | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
        | project Host, Source = "Session", EventTime = Timestamp
    ),
    (
        Process_ProcessStatistics
        | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
        | project Host, Source = "Process", EventTime = Timestamp
    ),
    (
        Application_Errors
        | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
        | project Host, Source = "Application", EventTime = Timestamp
    )
| where isnotempty(Host)
| where Host in (FilteredHosts)
| summarize
    SourceCount = dcount(Source),
    Sources = make_set(Source, 10),
    LastSeen = max(EventTime),
    InventoryLastSeen = maxif(EventTime, Source == "Inventory"),
    AgentLastSeen = maxif(EventTime, Source == "Agent"),
    PerformanceLastSeen = maxif(EventTime, Source == "Performance"),
    SessionLastSeen = maxif(EventTime, Source == "Session"),
    ProcessLastSeen = maxif(EventTime, Source == "Process"),
    ApplicationLastSeen = maxif(EventTime, Source == "Application")
    by Host
| extend CoveragePercent = round(
    100.0 * todouble(SourceCount) / 6.0,
    1
)
| extend CoverageStatus = case(
    SourceCount >= 5, "Complete",
    SourceCount >= 3, "Partial",
    "Limited"
)
| summarize Hosts = dcount(Host) by CoverageStatus
| order by Hosts desc

// KQL-03514 — Agent heartbeat status
// Threshold parameters are dashboard strings converted to timespans.
let HealthyThreshold = totimespan(_healthyThreshold);
let WarningThreshold = totimespan(_warningThreshold);
let InventoryLookback = totimespan(_inventoryLookback);
let LatestInventory =
    System_MachineInventory
    | where Timestamp between (
        _endTime - InventoryLookback .. _endTime
    )
    | summarize arg_max(
        Timestamp,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HwManufacturer,
        HwModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
    ) by Host
    | extend HardwareModel = trim(
        " ",
        strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel)
    )
    | extend HardwareModel = iff(
        isempty(HardwareModel),
        "Unknown",
        HardwareModel
    )
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where OsPlatform in (_osPlatform) or isempty(_osPlatform)
    | where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
    | where OsVersion in (_osVersion) or isempty(_osVersion)
    | where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel)
        or isempty(_hardwareModel);
let LatestHeartbeat =
    License_LicenseInfo
    | where Timestamp <= _endTime
    | summarize arg_max(
        Timestamp,
        ProductVersion,
        LicensingState,
        LicensingModel
    ) by Host
    | project
        Host,
        AgentLastSeen = Timestamp,
        ProductVersion,
        LicensingState,
        LicensingModel;
LatestHeartbeat
| join kind=inner (
    LatestInventory
    | project
        Host,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HardwareModel
) on Host
| extend DataAge = _endTime - AgentLastSeen
| extend
    HeartbeatStatus = case(
        DataAge <= HealthyThreshold, "Healthy",
        DataAge <= WarningThreshold, "Warning",
        "Missing"
    ),
    DataAgeMinutes = datetime_diff(
        "minute",
        _endTime,
        AgentLastSeen
    )
| summarize Hosts = dcount(Host) by HeartbeatStatus
| order by Hosts desc

// KQL-00349 — Machine Performance Summary
// Multi Stat: CPU, RAM, Disk, Network Peak and IOPS

let InventoryLookback = totimespan(_inventoryLookback);

let LatestInventory =
    System_MachineInventory
    | where Timestamp between (
        _endTime - InventoryLookback .. _endTime
    )
    | summarize arg_max(
        Timestamp,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HwManufacturer,
        HwModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
    ) by Host
    | extend HardwareModel = trim(
        " ",
        strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel)
    )
    | extend HardwareModel = iff(
        isempty(HardwareModel),
        "Unknown",
        HardwareModel
    )
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where OsPlatform in (_osPlatform)
        or isempty(_osPlatform)
    | where OsName in (_osName)
        or isempty(_osName)
    | where OsVersion in (_osVersion)
        or isempty(_osVersion)
    | where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel)
        or isempty(_hardwareModel);

let PerformanceSummary =
    System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | join kind=inner (
        LatestInventory
        | project Host
    ) on Host
    | summarize
        CPUValue = round(
            avg(todouble(CPUUsagePercent)),
            1
        ),
        RAMValue = round(
            avg(todouble(RAMUsagePercent)),
            1
        ),
        DiskValue = round(
            avg(todouble(IOPercentDiskTime)),
            1
        ),
        NetworkPeakValue = round(
            max(todouble(NetUtilizationPercent)),
            1
        ),
        IOPSValue = round(
            avg(
                coalesce(todouble(IOPSRead), 0.0)
                + coalesce(todouble(IOPSWrite), 0.0)
            ),
            1
        );

union
    (
        PerformanceSummary
        | project
            SortOrder = 1,
            Metric = "CPU Avg (%)",
            MetricValue = CPUValue
    ),
    (
        PerformanceSummary
        | project
            SortOrder = 2,
            Metric = "RAM Avg (%)",
            MetricValue = RAMValue
    ),
    (
        PerformanceSummary
        | project
            SortOrder = 3,
            Metric = "Disk Avg (%)",
            MetricValue = DiskValue
    ),
    (
        PerformanceSummary
        | project
            SortOrder = 4,
            Metric = "Network Peak (%)",
            MetricValue = NetworkPeakValue
    ),
    (
        PerformanceSummary
        | project
            SortOrder = 5,
            Metric = "IOPS Avg",
            MetricValue = IOPSValue
    )
| order by SortOrder asc
| project
    Metric,
    MetricValue

// KQL-00350 — Machine performance by host
let Metric = _metric;
let InventoryLookback = totimespan(_inventoryLookback);
let LatestInventory =
    System_MachineInventory
    | where Timestamp between (
        _endTime - InventoryLookback .. _endTime
    )
    | summarize arg_max(
        Timestamp,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HwManufacturer,
        HwModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
    ) by Host
    | extend HardwareModel = trim(
        " ",
        strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel)
    )
    | extend HardwareModel = iff(
        isempty(HardwareModel),
        "Unknown",
        HardwareModel
    )
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where OsPlatform in (_osPlatform) or isempty(_osPlatform)
    | where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
    | where OsVersion in (_osVersion) or isempty(_osVersion)
    | where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel)
        or isempty(_hardwareModel);
System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| join kind=inner (
    LatestInventory
    | project
        Host,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HardwareModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
) on Host
| summarize
    CPUPercent = round(avg(CPUUsagePercent), 1),
    DiskTimePercent = round(avg(IOPercentDiskTime), 1),
    RAMPercent = round(avg(toreal(RAMUsagePercent)), 1),
    NetworkPercent = round(avg(NetUtilizationPercent), 1),
    IOPS = round(
        avg(
            coalesce(IOPSRead, 0.0)
            + coalesce(IOPSWrite, 0.0)
        ),
        1
    )
    by Host, OsPlatform, OsName, OsVersion, HardwareModel
| extend
    MetricValue = case(
        Metric == "CPU", CPUPercent,
        Metric == "RAM", RAMPercent,
        Metric == "Disk", DiskTimePercent,
        Metric == "Network", NetworkPercent,
        Metric == "IOPS", IOPS,
        CPUPercent
    ),
    Unit = iff(Metric == "IOPS", "IOPS", "%")
| project
    Host,
    Metric,
    MetricValue,
    Unit,
    CPUPercent,
    RAMPercent,
    DiskTimePercent,
    NetworkPercent,
    IOPS,
    OsPlatform,
    OsName,
    OsVersion,
    HardwareModel
| order by MetricValue desc

// KQL-00351 — Selected Metric Usage Trend
// Displays the performance metric selected in the _metric parameter.

let SelectedMetric = tostring(_metric);
let TimeBin = totimespan(_timeBin);
let InventoryLookback = totimespan(_inventoryLookback);

let LatestInventory =
    System_MachineInventory
    | where Timestamp between (
        _endTime - InventoryLookback .. _endTime
    )
    | summarize arg_max(
        Timestamp,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HwManufacturer,
        HwModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
    ) by Host
    | extend HardwareModel = trim(
        " ",
        strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel)
    )
    | extend HardwareModel = iff(
        isempty(HardwareModel),
        "Unknown",
        HardwareModel
    )
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where OsPlatform in (_osPlatform)
        or isempty(_osPlatform)
    | where OsName in (_osName)
        or isempty(_osName)
    | where OsVersion in (_osVersion)
        or isempty(_osVersion)
    | where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel)
        or isempty(_hardwareModel);

let MetricTrend =
    System_SystemPerformanceSummary2
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | join kind=inner (
        LatestInventory
        | project Host
    ) on Host
    | summarize
        CPUUsagePercent = round(
            avg(todouble(CPUUsagePercent)),
            1
        ),
        RAMUsagePercent = round(
            avg(todouble(RAMUsagePercent)),
            1
        ),
        DiskTimePercent = round(
            avg(todouble(IOPercentDiskTime)),
            1
        ),
        NetworkPeakPercent = round(
            max(todouble(NetUtilizationPercent)),
            2
        ),
        AverageIOPS = round(
            avg(
                coalesce(todouble(IOPSRead), 0.0)
                + coalesce(todouble(IOPSWrite), 0.0)
            ),
            1
        )
        by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin);

union
    (
        MetricTrend
        | where SelectedMetric == "CPU"
        | project
            TimeBucket,
            Series = "CPU Usage (%)",
            Value = CPUUsagePercent
    ),
    (
        MetricTrend
        | where SelectedMetric == "RAM"
        | project
            TimeBucket,
            Series = "RAM Usage (%)",
            Value = RAMUsagePercent
    ),
    (
        MetricTrend
        | where SelectedMetric == "Disk"
        | project
            TimeBucket,
            Series = "Disk Active Time (%)",
            Value = DiskTimePercent
    ),
    (
        MetricTrend
        | where SelectedMetric == "Network"
        | project
            TimeBucket,
            Series = "Network Peak (%)",
            Value = NetworkPeakPercent
    ),
    (
        MetricTrend
        | where SelectedMetric == "IOPS"
        | project
            TimeBucket,
            Series = "Average IOPS",
            Value = AverageIOPS
    )
| order by TimeBucket asc, Series asc

    | summarize arg_max(

// KQL-00357 — Machine storage inventory summary
let MinVolumeSizeMB = tolong(_minVolumeSizeMB);
let InventoryLookback = totimespan(_inventoryLookback);
let LatestInventory =
    System_MachineInventory
    | where Timestamp between (
        _endTime - InventoryLookback .. _endTime
    )
    | summarize arg_max(
        Timestamp,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HwManufacturer,
        HwModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
    ) by Host
    | extend HardwareModel = trim(
        " ",
        strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel)
    )
    | extend HardwareModel = iff(
        isempty(HardwareModel),
        "Unknown",
        HardwareModel
    )
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where OsPlatform in (_osPlatform) or isempty(_osPlatform)
    | where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
    | where OsVersion in (_osVersion) or isempty(_osVersion)
    | where HardwareModel in (_hardwareModel)
        or isempty(_hardwareModel);
System_VolumeInventory
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend VolumeKey = iff(
    isnotempty(DeviceName),
    DeviceName,
    MountPoints
)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host, VolumeKey
| where CapacityMB >= MinVolumeSizeMB
| where not(FileSystem =~ "RAW")
| join kind=inner (
    LatestInventory
    | project
        Host,
        OsPlatform,
        OsName,
        OsVersion,
        HardwareModel,
        HwIsVirtualMachine,
        RAMSizeGB,
        CPUCoresLogical
) on Host
| summarize
    Hosts = dcount(Host),
    Volumes = count(),
    HardwareModels = dcount(HardwareModel),
    AvgUsedSpacePercent = round(avg(UsedSpacePercent), 1),
    TotalCapacityGB = round(sum(toreal(CapacityMB)) / 1024.0, 1),
    TotalFreeGB = round(sum(toreal(FreeMB)) / 1024.0, 1)

| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host, VolumeKey
| where CapacityMB >= MinVolumeSizeMB

| extend DriveOnHost = strcat(Path, " on ", Host)
| top 10 by FreeMB asc
| project
    Host,
    DriveOnHost,
    UsedSpaceGB,
    FreeSpaceGB,
    UsedSpacePercent,
    HardwareModel

| where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
| where isnotempty(OsVersion)
| summarize by Value = OsVersion
| order by Value asc

System_MachineInventory
| where Timestamp between (
    _endTime - totimespan(_inventoryLookback) .. _endTime
)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Host
| where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
| where OsPlatform in (_osPlatform) or isempty(_osPlatform)
| where OsName in (_osName) or isempty(_osName)
| where OsVersion in (_osVersion) or isempty(_osVersion)
| extend Value = trim(
    " ",
    strcat(HwManufacturer, " ", HwModel)
)
| extend Value = iff(isempty(Value), "Unknown", Value)
| summarize by Value
| order by Value asc
